name: Breadcrumb
description: A breadcrumb shows where the current page sits in the site’s hierarchy, with links back up each level. Long trails collapse into an expandable “…”.
whenToUse: On pages two or more levels deep in a hierarchy: product categories, docs, settings.

whenNotToUse.text: On the home page or top-level pages.

anatomy.name: Links
anatomy.description: Each level above the current page.

anatomy.name: Separator
anatomy.description: Chevron; flips in RTL; hidden from screen readers.

values.meaning: Shows the first, “…”, and the last n − 2.

behavior.text: Wraps onto more lines on narrow screens instead of scrolling.
A navigation landmark named “Breadcrumb”; the trail is an ordered list.

content: Use each page’s real title, shortened if long.
Don’t include the site name unless it’s a level.

guidelines.dont: Show the path people happened to click through.
Let a trail wrap onto three lines.
guidelines.why: Long trails push the page content down.

guidelines.do: Keep the current page as plain text.
guidelines.dont: Link the current page to itself.
guidelines.why: A link to the same page is confusing.

accessibility.role: navigation landmark with an ordered list.

keyboard.action: Reach and follow each link or the “…” button.

accessibility.focus: Pressing “…” keeps focus in the trail.

wcag.how: Shows the page’s place in the site.
Ordered list inside a named nav.

examples.title: Breadcrumb
With a router
examples.code:
import { Breadcrumb } from '@ds/react';

<Breadcrumb items={trail.map((t) => ({ ...t, onClick: (e) => { e.preventDefault(); navigate(t.href); } }))} />

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description: Shows where the current page sits in the site’s hierarchy, with links back up.

items.description: From the top level down to the current page (last).

maxItems.description:
Shows at most this many items; the middle collapses into a “…” button that expands
them. At least 3.

expandLabel.description: Accessible name of the “…” button. Default "Show all pages".

--breadcrumb-link-text-color.description: Tone-colored text directly on surfaces, e.g. text buttons and links.

--breadcrumb-link-hover-text-color.description: Tone-colored text directly on surfaces, e.g. text buttons and links.

--breadcrumb-separator-color.description: Supporting text on surfaces: descriptions, metadata, placeholders.

--breadcrumb-gap.description: Tightest gap between tightly related items, e.g. icon and label.

--breadcrumb-font-family.description: Body text and most UI text.

--breadcrumb-border-radius.description: Small rounding for tiny elements: checkboxes, tags.

--breadcrumb-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring.

--breadcrumb-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between an element and its focus ring.

--breadcrumb-focus-ring-color.description: Focus ring color; follows the brand accent.
